  - average_speed: float
}
class Inventory

}

"Bike Path" <|-- "Auto-generated"
"Bike Path" <|-- "Manually generated"
User <|-- "Registered User"

Sensors <|-- IMU
API <|-- Weather

Inventory "1" *--	"1..*" "Bike Path"
"Bike Path" "1..*" o-- "1..*"	Street
User "1..*" --> "0..*"	Inventory : query
"Registered User" "1" --> "0..*"	Trip : register
"Registered User" "1" --> "0..*"	"Bike Path" : insert
"Bike Path" "1..*" --> "1" Navigation : call
"Auto-generated" "1..*" -->	"1..*" Sensors : acquire
Trip "1..*" -->	"1..*"	Sensors : acquire
Trip "1..*" --> "1"	Weather : call
"Registered User" "1..*" --> "1..*" Street : report
